title: Signature: Shadow-permission detector
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): effective permissions are computed and compared against intended permissions; anything effective-but-unintended is a shadow permission. Shadows often come from nested group memberships or forgotten delegations. The detector reports each shadow with the path that created it. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers computing effective permissions from all sources.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"intended": {"read"}, "via_groups": {"write"}}, 2: {"intended": {"read", "write"}, "via_groups": {"delete"}}, 3: {"intended": {"read"}, "via_groups": {"write", "delete"}}}
intended, via = CFG[LEVEL]["intended"], CFG[LEVEL]["via_groups"]
effective = intended | via
shadows = effective - intended
print("effective:", sorted(effective), "| shadows:", sorted(shadows) or ["none"])
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Break-glass with alarm
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): emergencies allow break-glass override of permission denials, but the override fires loud alarms: immediate notifications, a mandatory incident ticket, and a full recording of everything done under break-glass. The alarm is the price of the override. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers allowing emergency override of denials.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "db-down", 2: "data-loss", 3: "security-incident"}
emergency = CFG[LEVEL]
ticket = "INC-%d" % (abs(hash(emergency)) % 9000 + 1000)
print("BREAK-GLASS invoked for:", emergency)
print("alarm: paged oncall | ticket:", ticket, "| session recording: ON")

title: Signature: Permission simulation
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): before granting, administrators run a simulation answering 'what could this identity do?' against the proposed policy. The simulation lists every reachable action on every resource, so over-broad grants are caught before they take effect. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers simulating proposed grants before applying.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ["read"], 2: ["read", "write"], 3: ["read", "write", "delete"]}
proposed = set(CFG[LEVEL])
resources = ["db1", "db2"]
reachable = [(r, a) for r in resources for a in proposed]
print("proposed scopes:", sorted(proposed))
print("reachable actions:", len(reachable), "| sample:", reachable[:3])
